events.title: 선덜랜드 , struggling in Division One, sack Malcolm Crosby as manager, nine months after he led them to the FA Cup final .
블랙번 로버스's title challenge continues to fade with a 2–1 home defeat to 크리스털 팰리스, with the result boosting the visiting side's survival bid.
Nearly seven years after selling him to 애스턴 빌라, 아스널 buy 마틴 키온 from 에버턴 for £2 million.
테리 버처 is named as the new manager of 선덜랜드, one year after being sacked by 코번트리 시티 .

맨체스터 유나이티드 regain their lead of the Premier League on goal difference, beating 셰필드 유나이티드 2–1 at Old Trafford after coming from a goal behind. Second-placed 애스턴 빌라 beat 입스위치 타운 2–0 at home. Oldham boost their survival hopes but remain in the bottom three with a 3–1 win over 첼시 at Boundary Park. The biggest drama in Division One sees 밀월 move one point short of the top two with a 5–2 home win over 왓퍼드, while 더비 카운티 have slid into the bottom half of the table with a 3–2 defeat at home to Peterborough.
맨체스터 유나이티드 remain top of the Premier League despite being held to a goalless draw by Leeds at Elland Road.

입스위치 타운 and QPR draw 1–1 at Portman Road. 셰필드 유나이티드 climb off the bottom of the Premier League table with a 2–0 win over 미들즈브러, who are now just one place outside the relegation zone following a run of bad results. Among the midweek action in Division One is 뉴캐슬 유나이티드's fifth defeat of the season, a 2–0 reverse at 포츠머스, but they remain firmly in the lead at the top of the table.

윔블던 continue their climb up the table with a 1–0 win over 아스널 at Highbury . 애스턴 빌라 miss the chance to go top, losing 1–0 to 크리스털 팰리스 at Selhurst Park, with the result helping the hosts move further clear of the relegation zone. 노리치 시티's title hopes are hit by a 3–0 defeat at 사우샘프턴.
뉴캐슬 유나이티드 sign 21-year-old striker Andy Cole from 브리스틀 시티 for a club record £1.75 million.
맨체스터 유나이티드's double hopes are ended when they lose 2–1 to 셰필드 유나이티드 at Bramall Lane in the FA Cup fifth round. 스티브 브루스 misses a penalty.

Paul Compton resigns as 토키 유나이티드 manager hours after a defeat by Division Three leaders 카디프 시티, which leaves Torquay bottom of the entire Football League and in serious danger of relegation to the Conference. Neil Warnock , who joined the club only days beforehand as a "footballing consultant", replaces Compton as manager.

이언 포터필드 is sacked after less than two years as manager of 첼시. David Webb , who left the 사우스엔드 유나이티드 job last summer, is appointed as 첼시's new manager on a trial contract until the end of the season. Alan Shearer will miss the rest of the season following surgery on his knee injury.
England achieve a third successive win in their World Cup qualifying series, triumphing 6–0 over San Marino at Wembley.

애스턴 빌라 return to the top of the Premier League with a 2–1 home win over 에버턴, but 맨체스터 유나이티드 keep the pressure on them when two late goals from 라이언 긱스 give them a 2–1 home win over 사우샘프턴 after a goal from substitute Nicky Banger put the Saints in the lead. 노리치 시티 keep their title bid going with a 2–1 home win over 맨체스터 시티. 노팅엄 포리스트 boost their survival bid with a 2–1 away win over 미들즈브러. QPR move up to fourth win a 2–0 home win over Coventry, who drop two places to seventh. 토트넘 홋스퍼's upturn continues with a 4–0 home win over Leeds, in which 테디 셰링엄 scores the club's first Premier League hat-trick.

블랙번 로버스 win 2–0 at home to 첼시, although they are still 12 points off the top they have two games in hand. The top two clubs in Division One, 웨스트햄 유나이티드 and 뉴캐슬 유나이티드, grind out a goalless draw at Upton Park.
셰필드 유나이티드 climb out of the relegation zone with a 2–0 home win over Oldham, who are now bottom of the table and four points adrift of safety.
셰필드 웬즈데이 climb into fourth place with a 2–1 win over 맨체스터 시티 at Maine Road, sparking talk of a possible late run for the Premier League title.
노팅엄 포리스트 climb out of the relegation zone with a 1–0 win over QPR at the City Ground .
애스턴 빌라 remain top of the Premier League with a 1–0 home win over 윔블던, although 맨체스터 유나이티드 are still just two points of them with a game in hand after a 3–0 win over 미들즈브러 at Old Trafford.

February ends with 애스턴 빌라 top of the Premier League, two points ahead of 맨체스터 유나이티드, who have a match in hand. 노리치 시티, 셰필드 웬즈데이 and 블랙번 로버스 complete the top five. 올덤 애슬레틱 prop up the table, with 미들즈브러 and 셰필드 유나이티드 joining them in the bottom three. Division One leaders 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 have a seven-point margin over their nearest rivals 웨스트햄 유나이티드, and the playoff zone is occupied by 밀월, 스윈던 타운, 포츠머스 and 트랜미어 로버스. 그림즈비 타운's unlikely promotion challenge continues as they are just three goals away from a place in the top six. An improvement in form has seen 노츠 카운티 and 루턴 타운 climb out of the bottom three and ease their fears of a second successive relegation; the relegation zone now consists of Southend, 브리스틀 로버스 and Birmingham. The only league action of the day is a goalless draw between 노리치 시티 and 블랙번 로버스 at Carrow Road , a result which does no favours to the Premier League title ambitions of either team.
